# MyUNI / MyUNI Lab
> Official AI-readable summary for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
> Canonical site: https://myunilab.net

## Entity
- Name: MyUNI
- Alternate names: MyUNI Lab, MyUNI Eğitim Platformu, myunilab.net
- Type: EducationalOrganization / online learning platform
- Website: https://myunilab.net
- Languages: Turkish (tr), English (en)
- Focus: AI-powered online education, career skills, certificates, training packages, and events

## What MyUNI is
MyUNI (myunilab.net) is an AI-supported online education platform that helps learners develop technology and career skills through courses, multi-course training packages (paket), live/hybrid programs, and events. Completing programs may award a MyUNI completion certificate.
